GEO.thesis: GEO is a top-decile momentum leader (above 50- and 200-day, +62.7pts relative strength vs SPY over 3m, RSI 60.9 with headroom) whose price move is running ahead of a thinly-covered estimate base, and that gap is the opportunity rather than the warning. The load-bearing variant view is that -$55.7M FCF against ~$260M net income is idle-bed reactivation capex against contracted capacity — spending that is most negative immediately before it inflects — while four analysts at a $33.75 pre-rally anchor have not marked the ramp, which is why revisions score only 60.3 against a +67% quarter. Demand is appropriations-driven, so the growth-scare leg of the current regime that de-rates Industrials peers should not touch GEO's revenue base; the live macro risk is the rate leg against 1.11x D/E, not the cycle. Positioning is loaded: 11.1% of float short and rising ~570k shares into a rising tape, 96% institutional ownership, into an Aug 6 BMO print where a backlog or occupancy disclosure forces covering and target hikes simultaneously. Sized for 53% vol, not for enthusiasm — shares, small, with the print as the arbiter.

PSX.thesis: PSX pairs a top-decile factor profile (momentum 100, value 86) with confirmed price leadership — above the 50- and 200-day, +25.98 relative strength over 3m — inside the only leading sector while SPY trades below its 50DMA; cheap-and-inflecting is the configuration that historically pays and is the opposite of a value trap. The valuation objection rests on trailing EPS of $10.11 that fell 56.8%, which is what a refiner looks like at cycle trough, not what expensive looks like; the honest lens is 10.96x forward and 0.62x sales. I do not claim a variant view on crack-spread recovery — that is published consensus — so this is a trend-and-regime position, not a mispricing call, and it is sized as such. Quality 43, negative free cash flow and reported profit leaning on affiliate/non-operating income are real defects that cap conviction and forbid concentration. Own in shares at standard weight, staged, with adds reserved for a pullback toward the 50-day rather than a fill at a +22.6% one-month extension.

MSBI.thesis: MSBI's earnings normalization is now verified by primary filings rather than modeled: consecutive GAAP diluted EPS of $0.74 and $0.82 bracket the -$0.24 Q4'25 loss, so forward EPS of ~$3.38 is the printed first-half run-rate annualized and 9.8x forward is arithmetic. The driver is the highest-quality kind for a bank — spread and funding mix (loan repricing plus $267M of core deposits displacing brokered funding), not volume or leverage — showing up pre-provision at PPNR/assets of 2.01% and at ROTCE 16.27%, while the balance sheet de-risks via $94.9M of specialty-finance runoff and CET1 builds to 10.39%. The mispricing is structural neglect, not disagreement: four analysts at a 3.0 Hold with a $33.25 target anchored to a damaged trailing record that mechanically must be marked up as the run-rate repeats. At 1.5x book on a mid-teens ROTCE, 11-12x forward maps to $37-41 against a stoppable break of the 50-DMA and a soft book floor near $22-27. This is a shares-only, revision-cycle position sized modestly for small-cap gap risk, not a compounder — loans are shrinking and NIM expansion is already decelerating.

PEB.thesis: PEB's retained portfolio is compounding faster than the consolidated numbers show: the -0.1% headline revenue is a disposition artifact and the correct unit is per-share AFFO (+23.8% YTD), driven by genuine operating leverage plus a contracted 27%/$6.1M property-insurance cut that flows through May 2027 with zero further RevPAR help. Sell-side is stale and mechanically behind — 15 analysts at a 2.81 hold with an $18.62 mean target set before the 7/29 beat-and-raise, against a revisions factor of 73.7 that is the only evidence leg in this packet not collinear with price — so estimate and target markups, not multiple expansion, are the identified re-rate path. Downside is anchored (not floored) by $2.15B equity against $4.89B net hotel book on already-depreciated urban/resort assets, with the trend intact above a rising 50/200-DMA and RSI at 54.4 after a +38% quarter — confirmation-stage entry without paying for extension. I explicitly do NOT underwrite the $258M company-defined FCF at face value (capex lull) nor claim a cash-flow discount at 10-11x EV/EBITDA, and I treat the 30Y-at-2007-highs rate regime as a hard size cap on a 4-5.5x-levered REIT rather than as a veto, because that input reaches me through the news tape this firm has measured as net-harmful to conviction. Standard-size shares position, 6-12 month horizon, sized as correlated duration risk.

CORT.thesis: CORT is a top-decile momentum name whose trend is corroborated by an independent fundamental input — estimate revisions at 87.1 — which is the one factor this firm's own forward data shows is predictive, and the load-bearing pillar here rests on it rather than on cheapness or quality alone. The variant view is narrow but real: visible coverage is four analysts anchored on the 259x trailing print and 11.7% of float is short and rising, while the forward multiple (25.3x, PEG 0.81) on a debt-free 31.7% grower is being marked up, not down. I am explicitly NOT crediting the two speculative headlines, the macro-data promotion reason, or the neutral sector tag as pillars. The entry is the weak link: RSI 70.1, +26% in a month, 71.2% annualized vol, and no name-specific catalyst for 82 days — so this is a starter clip sized off the vol, with the add explicitly gated on the consolidation the technical desk specified or on the Nov 4 print. If the ramp is on track, the full position gets built at a better price or on confirmed fundamentals; if it is not, a 3.5% starter is the entire cost of being wrong.

TSM.thesis: TSM is the leading-edge bottleneck that the AI capex cycle must clear, and NVDA's 8/26 10-Q and 8-K — a primary filing, the only news-like input this firm's ledger says has paid — disclosed a supply-constrained +70% FY28 outlook and ~$1.3T of 2027 hyperscaler capex, which for a sole-source foundry is a statement about TSM's own order book and pricing power rather than a sentiment read-through. The load-bearing variant is narrow but real: consensus underwrites 2-4pt/yr gross-margin dilution from Arizona/Japan/Germany, yet TSM is printing 56% operating and 50% net margin while ramping that capacity, so $21.78 forward EPS is closer to a floor than a target. Critically, this call requires no multiple expansion — at 19.5x forward, PEG 1.0, and 39% ROE built on margin and turnover rather than leverage (D/E 0.15, Piotroski 8), the Taiwan single-island discount can persist permanently and the thesis still works on earnings alone. The one factor firm memory says still carries information — earnings-revision breadth at 96.8 — points the right way, while the momentum and quality ranks that screen best here are explicitly down-weighted as anti-predictive this period. Catalyst path is the September and October monthly revenue disclosures as interim confirmation of foundry loading, then the 10/15 print.
